verses.text: How blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, Nor stand in the path of sinners, Nor sit in the seat of scoffers!
verses.textZh: 不從惡人的計謀，不站罪人的道路，不坐褻慢人的座位，

verses.text: But his delight is in the law of the LORD, And in His law he meditates day and night.
verses.textZh: 惟喜愛耶和華的律法，晝夜思想，這人便為有福！

verses.text: He will be like a tree [firmly] planted by streams of water, Which yields its fruit in its season And its leaf does not wither; And in whatever he does, he prospers.
verses.textZh: 他要像一棵樹栽在溪水旁，按時候結果子，葉子也不枯乾。凡他所做的盡都順利。

verses.text: The wicked are not so, But they are like chaff which the wind drives away.
verses.textZh: 惡人並不是這樣，乃像糠秕被風吹散。

verses.text: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, Nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
verses.textZh: 因此，當審判的時候惡人必站立不住；罪人在義人的會中也是如此。

verses.text: For the LORD knows the way of the righteous, But the way of the wicked will perish.
verses.textZh: 因為耶和華知道義人的道路；惡人的道路卻必滅亡。
